name: ideation
description: Single-plugin marketplace for ideation: one /ideation entry point that plans at the right depth (a no-files 'should we?' opening, just do it, a short plan, an evidence-gated interview, or a multi-session map), writes a versioned plan you answer on a page, and runs what you approve in the terminal.

plugins.name: ideation
plugins.description: One /ideation entry point, at the right depth: just do it, a short plan, an evidence-gated interview stress-tested by four adversarial plan critics, or a map for foggy multi-session work, opening with a no-files 'should we?' conversation when the question is whether to build at all. Every depth writes a living, versioned plan (plan.json) you answer on a page or in the terminal. Approval is always a terminal confirmation, and it hands the run contract to a deterministic workflow engine that builds, reviews and commits each unit. Watched runs teach the next interview.
